9c42e2140c101bdf.title: Walktober: Arroyo's Edge - An Exploration of Architecture with Nature as Inspiration
9c42e2140c101bdf.desc: Join the Gamble House and the One Arroyo Foundation for a walk focused on the Arroyo's architectural history and natural beauty. The Gamble House is pleased to participate in WALKTOBER PASADENA, the 9th Annual Celebration of Walking in Pasadena! Join us for a guided two-part walk through the Arroyo Terrace neighborhood, exploring the remarkable architecture, history, and ecology of this unique setting. Led by a Gamble House docent, the first half of the walk will explore the National Register Historic District, home to nine Greene & Greene houses whose location, design, and materials reflect a deep connection to the Arroyo Seco landscape.
